subject: CPPO launch: reseller integration & entitlement cutover plan
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>; account-team@globaltech.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO launch: reseller integration & entitlement cutover plan

Hi team,

Thanks again for aligning on the Channel Partner Private Offer for GlobalTech (PP-4832). To keep momentum for the July go-live window, I put together an integration / cutover plan attached (entitlement-mapping-v1.xlsx + merchant-onboarding-checklist.pdf). High level asks for CloudResell:

- Confirm merchant account registration status in AWS Marketplace and share the merchant ID by EOD Thu (we need it for CPPO entitlement mapping).
- Validate the SKU <-> Redwood entitlement rows in the attached spreadsheet and flag any mismatches.
- Approve the reseller amendment draft (attached) or send redlines by Monday 07/06 so we can route to legal.

Operational notes:
- We will do a test purchase (US billing) next Wednesday 07/07. Please nominate a technical contact for the test and confirm whether you want the test transaction as sandbox or live (we recommend live with a $1 token purchase to validate billing routing).
- Ben will lead the entitlement provisioning with AWS once merchant ID is confirmed. Soojin will own DocuSign for the amendment. Laura will coordinate invoicing split rules.

If anything is blocked (merchant registration, PO flow, or DocuSign parity), call that out now — we have an AWS support case available (1234567890) if the merchant needs faster verification.

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CPPO launch: reseller integration & entitlement cutover plan

Priyom —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick updates from ops:

- Merchant account: registered last week. Merchant ID: 9876543210. We attached our internal merchant confirmation (PDF) to our ticket; happy to share a screenshot if you need it to feed to AWS.
- We've started reviewing the entitlement mapping. Two SKUs look like they will require price alignment (rows highlighted).
- Draft amendment: we have two redlines around invoicing cadence and tax pass-through; attached a redlined doc next.

Test purchase: we can run the live $1 token test on 2026-07-07. I'll assign our engineer, Maria Lopez (maria@cloudresell.com), to coordinate the purchase and verify Seller ID routing. Maria will join the 07/06 check-in.

Blockers: we will need explicit instructions for the PO flow when a customer sends a PO to Redwood and asks for the invoice to be split between Redwood and CloudResell. Our finance team wants a documented sequence of events and sample invoices.

We will upload the merchant confirmation to the AWS case and can push for expedited evidence review.

Best,

--
CloudResell Ops
ops@cloudresell.com
Attachment stubs: cloudresell-merchant-confirmation.pdf, cloudresell-amendment-redlines.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO launch: reseller integration & entitlement cutover plan

Looping in the operational checklist for the PO/invoice split:

- Sequence we recommend:
  1) Customer sends PO to Redwood (copy to CloudResell).
  2) Redwood issues two invoices: (A) Redwood portion to customer, (B) CloudResell commission/entitlement invoice to CloudResell (we mark PO reference on both).
  3) CloudResell invoices customer only if contract requires direct billing — otherwise CloudResell invoices Redwood for reseller commission.

- For AWS billing routing on CPPO: we need to confirm the SKU entitlement lines are published under CloudResell's merchant ID. If they are under Redwood's merchant ID, AWS will route revenue differently (and could break marketplace entitlements).

Action items for CloudResell before 07/06 check-in:
- Share merchant ID (received — thanks). Please confirm which SKU rows you want published under your merchant ID vs Redwood's.
- Provide finance sample invoice(s) showing the split. If you can't produce a sample, tell us the preferred flow and we'll create draft invoices for your review.

I'll prepare a short runbook for the test purchase and hand it to Maria. If AWS needs evidence, Soojin — please prep the DocuSign envelope so the amendment can be executed quickly.

Cheers,
--
Ben Carter
Channel Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: po-invoice-sample.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO launch: reseller integration & entitlement cutover plan

Appreciate the fast follow — a couple of clarifications and next steps before the 07/07 test:

- CloudResell, thanks for merchant ID 9876543210. Ben, please confirm by tomorrow that the highlighted SKUs can be assigned to CloudResell in the entitlement spreadsheet. If not, we will need to re-publish and that pushes timelines.
- Maria, please use the runbook Ben will share and do the live $1 purchase on 07/07 at 10:00 PT. Post-test, we will validate billing routing and invoice visibility in the AWS reports.
- Soojin, please send the DocuSign envelope for the amendment today; CloudResell indicated two redlines — ensure we accept or counter in-line so procurement can sign.
- Laura, please draft two sample invoices (Redwood -> Customer, CloudResell -> Redwood commission) and drop them in the shared HubSpot record.

We'll run the post-test sync on Friday 07/09 at 09:00 PT to decide go/no-go. If all green, we target marketplace listing visibility by Monday 07/12.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a clean cutover.

--
Priyom Das
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
